channel.title: Today I Learned · Maimul
channel.description: One thing I learned, written up like a newspaper feature.

item.title: The Deploy That Went Green and Shipped Nothing
item.description: My home server's deploy failed at step one, and every step after it reported success. Here's how a failure goes missing in a deploy chain, and a copy-paste script that refuses to call nothing a success.

item.title: The Guard That Couldn’t Read, So It Waved the Commit Through
item.description: My AI coding agent was only allowed to commit code once the code passed my checks. One night the checks failed, the agent committed anyway, and the guard I'd built to stop exactly that did nothing. Here's why, in plain words, and the rule that fixes it.

item.title: Every Test Passed. Production Returned 500.
item.description: My test suite was green, my smoke test was green, and a photo upload in a FastAPI app I work on had never worked. Here's the Python behaviour that hid it, the test that now catches it, and why fixing the bug still didn't fix the feature.

item.title: The Case of the Printer Nobody Could Reach
item.description: My iPhone could see my home printer, but it hadn't printed a page in 127 days. Here's how I tracked down why, what finally fixed it, and how to check your own setup when AirPrint goes quiet.

item.title: AirPrint for a Printer That Never Had It
item.description: My Epson L3250 doesn't support AirPrint, so my iPhone can't see it. One small container on my Synology NAS fixes that. Here's how it works, and how to set it up for your own printer.
